# Code of Conduct

We welcome precise technical disagreement, negative results, and strong
criticism. They are not abuse. Harassment, threats, doxxing, impersonation,
targeted intimidation, and sustained spam are unacceptable.

Maintainers preserve the minimum evidence needed for review and use
proportionate, reversible moderation. Moderation must never hide inconvenient
bugs, security concerns, data-loss reports, or criticism.

Report conduct concerns through GitHub's private reporting surfaces when
available. Do not post private personal information or security-sensitive
evidence in a public issue.
